params.caption: 🖥️ Nvidia: Vera CPU gets up to 39% faster with software tuning At SC26, Nvidia showed that its Vera CPU, built on its own custom Olympus Arm cores, can gain nearly 39% in certain workloads once code is optimized for the architecture. The company says the chip already performs well on unoptimized code, but fine-tuning is needed to unlock its full potential. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 20:30 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @nvidia ⚡ React if Arm CPUs are the future · 💬 Would you want one in a gaming PC? #Nvidia #VeraCPU #SC26 #PCHardware #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
